title: A range that waited, returned and earned
explanation: A WETH-funded position began above its range, entered after 2h 12m 47s and received fees in 74 transactions. Most of its USD gain came from token exposure; the incremental LP contribution was about $1.04.
limitations: Dated historical simulation under observed flow; not an onchain trade by this application.
The positive case is an explanatory case study, not evidence of predictive selection or a current recommendation.
The complete market archive is not included. A curated retained-token accounting ledger is included for arithmetic checks; it cannot reproduce swap-level execution.
Gas is estimated and charged externally. Token marks are not guaranteed exit quotes.
